_comment: Examples on the start page: `python -m synvoy_web gallery build --spec THIS_FILE`. Paths are relative to this file. An example is either a pipeline output folder (run_dir) or a search that was run on this server (job). Optional per example: label (the release that made the run; without it the example reads pre-release), rename (a run started under an internal label is published under another name) and must_not_contain (words no published file may hold; the build stops and names the file).

examples.name: Apyrase
examples.about: Venom enzyme; honeybee protein as the query
